home.title: A home that feels like yours.
home.lead: Two RERA-registered projects in west Ahmedabad. Ask anything, at any hour, in English, Hindi or Gujarati, and book a site visit in a slot that is actually free.
home.step1Body: Answers come only from the registered project fact sheet. If something isn't there, a person will confirm it.
home.step2Body: Pick a free slot. You'll get a reminder a day before and again two hours before.
home.step3Body: A named member of our sales team meets you at the site office.
home.personBody: Ask for a person at any point in the chat and a member of our sales team will call you.

footer.priceNote: Prices are indicative and exclude government charges. The final price for a home is confirmed by our sales team.
